Sandbox_EnshroudedSleep_Enabled_tooltip: When some but not all living players are asleep, compress world/calendar time by changing MinutesPerDay. Vanilla Project Zomboid still controls sleep eligibility and full-sleep fast-forward.
Sandbox_EnshroudedSleep_PartialSleepSpee: Scales the server FastForwardMultiplier for partial sleep only. 1.0 is neutral, 0.5 halves the partial-sleep compression, and 2.0 doubles it. The mod never changes the global simulation multiplier.
Sandbox_EnshroudedSleep_DiagnosticsEnabl: Development/support option. Logs one-second clock, sleep, health, survival-stat, nutrition, and injury telemetry on the multiplayer server and connected clients. This can produce very large log files. Leave disabled for normal play except during controlled diagnostics.
Sandbox_EnshroudedSleep_DiagnosticForced: Diagnostic forced compression factor (SERVER TEST ONLY)

SPIKE-004 server-test option. Only active when verbose diagnostics are enabled AND exactly one living player is connected to the multiplayer server and remains awake. Values above 1 force MinutesPerDay compression for that connected player. If the player sleeps or another living player connects, the override is suspended and native MinutesPerDay is restored. Use 1.0 for normal play.
